# GitHub Copilot / Agent Instructions

Purpose
-------
This file gives concise, repo-specific guidance for automated assistants (Copilot, chat agents) to operate safely and productively in this workspace. Keep guidance focused: link to canonical docs rather than copying them.

Quick Tasks (commands)
-----------------------
- Start dev frontend: `make dev_host` (Watcharr root)
- Start server: `make server` (Watcharr root)
- Run Docker compose (development): `docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up`
- Install deps / run scripts: `npm install` / `npm run dev` (see `package.json`)

Key files & docs (link, don't duplicate)
--------------------------------------
- Project README: [README.md](README.md)
- Contribution guide: [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- Feature list: [FEATURES.md](FEATURES.md)
- Server code: `server/` — backend services and API handlers
- Frontend code: `src/` — Svelte + TypeScript UI

Conventions & expectations
--------------------------
- Language/tooling: Svelte (frontend), TypeScript, Node, Docker Compose, Makefiles.
- Formatting: follow existing `tsconfig.json` and project ESLint/Prettier rules. Run project formatters before committing.
- Tests: run any available test scripts in `package.json` or Makefile targets; if none exist, open a short note before adding tests.

What the agent can/do
---------------------
- Suggest code changes limited to files matched by `applyTo` patterns below.
- Keep code in line with existing repo structure, style, and conventions.
- Propose small, self-contained refactors and fixes with tests or instructions to run them where applicable.
- Create or update documentation that links to canonical README/CONTRIBUTING rather than duplicating content.
- Avoid touching secrets, large binary/media files, or deployment credentials.

What the agent must not do
-------------------------
- Commit secrets or credentials. If secrets are required, prompt the human and document required env vars instead.
- Make large, intrusive architectural changes without explicit review and approval.
- Modify files outside the repository scope (no external systems, no remote servers).

ApplyTo (recommended)
----------------------
- `Watcharr/**`
- `Watcharr/src/**`
- `Watcharr/server/**`
- `Watcharr/*.svelte`
- `Watcharr/*.ts`
- `Watcharr/Makefile`
- Exclude: `!**/node_modules/**`, `!**/.git/**`, `Watcharr/server/data/**` and large media directories (e.g. `!Watcharr/static/**`).

PR / Edit checklist
-------------------
- Runs and passes relevant local commands (`make server`, `npm run build`, etc.).
- Code formatted and lints clean (per project rules).
- Tests added or updated for behavioral changes when feasible.
- Documentation updated with links to canonical docs (README/CONTRIBUTING).

Example prompts for this repo
----------------------------
- "Find Svelte components that use deprecated lifecycle hooks and suggest migration to current APIs."
- "Add a typed interface for the `User` object used in `server/` and update usages across frontend `src/` files."
- "Create a short PR template that reminds contributors to run `make server` and format code before pushing."
